offstage.note: Exposes offstage_doctor / offstage_route / offstage_run / offstage_probe. IMPORTANT: a plugin install only clones this repo -- it does not run npm install and does not build -- so dist/ and node_modules are absent and this server will not start until you run `npm ci` in the plugin root. Until offstage is published to a registry, prefer: claude mcp add offstage -- node /absolute/path/to/your/built/clone/dist/mcp/index.js
